description: This file defines the PimReportData class, which implements report data handling for the PIM (Personal Information Management) report within the OrangeHRM system. It manages report generation and metadata retrieval based on search filters.

classes.name: PimReportData
classes.description: Implements report data processing for PIM-related reports, providing normalization and metadata functions based on search filters.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Protected method that initializes and returns the singleton instance of ReportGeneratorService used for report data operations.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Prepares and returns normalized report data based on current filter parameters.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns report metadata, specifically the total count of report entries, encapsulated in a ParameterBag.
